result:
I changed `is_supported_version` in `mitmproxy/net/tls.py`. It now returns `False` when setting the min or max protocol version raises `SSL.Error`, instead of crashing. Some OpenSSL builds reject versions they were compiled without, so those versions are now reported as unsupported.

I didn't add a test or run the suite. A test would need to force `set_min_proto_version` to raise, and I didn't write one.

     # Without SECLEVEL, recent OpenSSL versions forbid old TLS versions.
     # https://github.com/pyca/cryptography/issues/9523

-    client_ctx.set_min_proto_version(version.value)
